title: Migration 1135 DROP TRIGGER deadlock C40P01 on TC-TNT-01-01 re-provisioning
notes: Follow-up D3 from the WF03-gh377-20260804 rework-1 retry: TC-TNT-01-01 re-provisions an existing tenant and hits C40P01 deadlock on DROP TRIGGER while another transaction holds the trigger row. Test then aborts mid-way.
root_cause: Likely: the migration runs DROP TRIGGER (or TRUNCATE-style statement) without NOWAIT, blocking on a long-running concurrent insert in TC-TNT-03-01 and TC-TNT-03-03. Need either advisory locking around the migration's trigger work, or reordering so TRUNCATE happens before concurrent test acquires the row.
repro_steps: 3. TC-TNT-01-01 hangs/deadlocks on DROP TRIGGER in 1135 migration
candidate_resolution: Acquire pg_advisory_xact_lock around the DROP TRIGGER block in migration 1135; or reorder so the per-tenant DROP TRIGGER happens before any concurrent test acquires the row. Verify deadlock-free under concurrent zig build test-integration.
acceptance_criteria: Migration 1135 acquires pg_advisory_xact_lock for its DROP TRIGGER block
prevention: Migration DDL that touches per-tenant triggers must acquire pg_advisory_xact_lock before DROP/CREATE.
Migration deadlock tests should run under the full concurrent zig build test-integration target, not sequentially.
